_note: Maps a data.gov.il registry record to a schedule id. Match order: make, then commercial name (kinuy_mishari, upper-case), then year range, then optional engine codes (degem_manoa) and fuel. First rule that matches wins; rules with engine_codes are checked before rules without. Engine codes seen in the registry: Hyundai/Kia G3LA=1.0 Kappa MPI, G4LA=1.25 Kappa, G4LF=1.2 Kappa MPI, G3LC=1.0 T-GDI, G4LE=1.6 GDI hybrid, G4FG=1.6 Gamma MPI, G4FD=1.6 Gamma GDI, G4FJ=1.6 T-GDI, G4NA=2.0 Nu; Toyota 1ZR=1.6, 2ZR=1.8 (hybrid on E210), 1NR/1KR=Yaris; Skoda CBZ/CJZ=1.2 TSI, CZD/CZE/DAD=1.4-1.5 TSI. Registry spells Mazda 'מזדה' with names 'MAZDA 3', 'MAZDA 2', 'MAZDA CX-30'. Alfa Romeo maker is 'אלפא רומיאו_אי'; names 'ALFA GIULIETTA', 'GIULIA', 'GIULIA Q4', 'STELVIO'; engine 55273835 = 2.0 T4 MultiAir (Quadrifoglio 2.9 V6 = 670050436, not covered). Toyota hybrids: fuel is 'בנזין' and the name carries HYBRID (e.g. 'C-HR HYBRID'). Registry Toyota name variants: COROLLA HSD SDN / COROLLA SDN HSD / COROLLA TS HSD / COROLLA HSD HB (E210 hybrid), COROLLA SDN (E210 petrol), RAV 4 HYBRID / RAV4 HV / RAV-4 / RAV4 GAS, TOYOTA C-HR (2021+, engine 2ZR = hybrid, 8NR = 1.2 turbo), YARIS CROSS HV. Hyundai/Kia hybrids: IONIQ HYBRID, NIRO, KONA HYBRID, ELANTRA HEV all have fuel 'בנזין'; engines G4LE (1.6 GDI hybrid), G4LL/G4LM (1.6 GDI hybrid, 2020+).
